###Chapter 1: REVENGE
Chapter 1: REVENGE
Do you know what it meant to be a runt among the shifters? It meant you would be the smallest and the weakest among all the other shifters around you. 
It was not usual for a werewolf to get sick easily, as it was well known that they had incredible healing ability. 
A shifter could be littered with severe wounds, but it would only need a few hours or at most a day for them to be able to get back to their original state. 
Therefore, you couldn't take a shifter lightly, a werewolf even more so, because they were at the top of the food chain. They were the predators. 
However, it didn't work that way for Iris. The only reason being she was a runt. 
Ever since she was born, she had been concurrently sick. She was also smaller than a normal shifter baby. In the first few years of her life, it was so hard even to feed her, it was a challenge, especially since she would get a fever every now and then. 
And when she reached the age of sixteen, she was not able to shift into her wolf due to her spirit being too weak for her to be able to do so. 
And now, when she was at the age of seventeen, when all the she- wolves would think this was the time when they would meet their mates, she didn't think she would find one. 
And above all of that, she was not able to hear. 
Iris could read people's lips, but she wouldn't be able to know what they were saying if they were not facing her when they spoke to her. 
If it was not for her father being the alpha of the Blue Moon pack, no one would even know about her, as she would spend most of her time inside her house and had a tutor come to help her with her education. 
Unfortunately, her life didn't get better even after she turned twenty. 
"Come out now!" Someone shouted behind Iris, as she sat on the cold floor of the dungeon with her head lowered. "Damn it! I forgot she couldn't hear!" The man cursed under his breath and opened the cell before he marched toward the skinny girl and yanked her arm to make her stand up. 
Iris gritted her teeth, she looked at the man with fear in her eyes. Her pack had fallen, they were defeated in a war and now she was a prisoner of war. She was the only daughter of the Alpha after all. 
"The Alpha wants to see you!" The man showed so much hostility in his eyes, as he grabbed her by the elbow and dragged her out of this filthy cell, where she had stayed for more than a week now. 
Iris couldn't hear him, but she could read his lips and she knew meeting the Alpha was inevitable. She trembled in fear. She hated being hurt. 
Iris stumbled on her feet a few times because she couldn't keep up with the guard's pace, yet he didn't slow down at all. 
She remembered this room, this room used to be the alpha's room and she had only entered it twice, since her father didn't really like her near him. 
She was born as a runt, thus it was a disgrace to him. 
"Alpha, I have brought Iris Lane with me," he said in a solemn voice, as he lowered his head and kicked Iris at the back of her knee until she knelt down before the alpha. 
Alpha Cane. 
He was a slave for ten years in this Blue Moon pack, since his pack, Howling Wolf, was razed by Iris's father and all of the pack members turned into slaves, including him, Cane Nortern, the then alpha's son. 
His world fell apart when he was twenty two, he went from the most respectable alpha's son to be a slave that held no value whatsoever. 
But right now, he managed to get his revenge and wiped out the Blue Moon pack, restored the glory of the Howling Wolf pack, and now he would get his revenge on Iris for what her father had done to him and his family. 
"You can leave, Will," Cane said in a cold tone, as he stood up from his seat and Iris trembled in fear at the sight of him. His body was even bigger than her brother's or her father's. He towered above her, looking down at her with so much malice in his dark eyes. 
The guard named Will walked out of the room and closed the door, leaving Iris with her predator. 
Iris tried to scamper away from him, but Cane had grabbed her shoulder and his grip was so painful. She felt like he would be able to crush her shoulder easily. 
"Undress and get on the bed," Cane said coldly, but because Iris didn't look at his face. She couldn't read his lips, so she missed the order and started whimpering. "Don't you hear me?!" 
Outraged, Cane dragged her to the bed himself and pinned her down. She was crying, but there was no sound that came out of her mouth, she just trembled at the sight of him. 
Cane had a long scar on his left face, traversed from his right eye across the bridge of his nose, ending on his left cheek. The scar was unsightly and he got this from when he was being a slave in the Blue Moon pack. 
Cane gathered her arms above her head and pinched her chin so she could look at him and the hatred in his eyes only made Iris feel scared even more. 
"See what I will do to you. I will give you hell like what your father gave to me." 
Iris could read that and she spoke in a soft voice, shaking all over. "Why me?" 
"Why me, you said?" 
Iris could feel her chin hurting further when he tightened his grip, but she needed to look at him, so she could understand what he said next. 
"Why don't you take your revenge on my father instead?"

How could that happen? And why? Did it happen only with her? 
Cane could answer the last question for sure that the lycan only reacted to her presence. Her scent could quench his thirst for blood and violence and with him touching her, keeping her close, he could remain as humane as he could in his cursed beast form. 
What was it with her?

###Chapter 60: HELPING OUT THE PACK
Chapter 60: HELPING OUT THE PACK

###Chapter 67: WHAT WILL YOU DO WITH THAT POWER?
Chapter 67: WHAT WILL YOU DO WITH THAT POWER?
Iris felt like she was walking into a bright room filled with blinding light, where the colorful glass that lined the walls diffused the light and scattered it into various colors on the tiled floor. 
It was a beautiful hall, but there was no one there except for her. She was alone, but at the same time, she didn’t feel she was alone, as if there was someone there to guide her.

Iris looked around her, but this hall was almost empty and there was nothing to look at, except for the tall podium in front of her.

Her legs guided her there, even without her realizing it. 
Iris climbed a few steps, leading to the podium, before she saw it.

However, the urge hit her again. She felt the need to touch those swords. She stretched out her hand, but before she could feel the cold steel, the light that lured her there, suddenly burst before her eyes before the room started to spin.

###Chapter 104: A SWINDLER

Hm! It tasted nice!

###Chapter 204: WINTER NIGHT

She was repulsed at herself for craving his blood. It took everything in her to stop herself from drinking his blood to sate her thirst. 
Aria didn’t know how long she had been like this or how many days or weeks had passed since she was with this sorcerer, but her last memory of the gallows started fading away from her mind, as if it was something that had happened years ago, yet at the same time, the emotions of that day were still so fresh. She could feel the pain of being strangled when she couldn’t breathe, as the rope tightened around her neck.
She could still feel the disappointment and misery that she felt that day when she couldn’t see him for one last time. He didn’t even grant her wish to see him in her last moments, but she still longed for him. 
"Don’t hurt yourself and come here," Dexter said softly, he treated her with kindness, if one could say. But there were a lot of things in Aria’s mind and heart to see that. 
The sorcerer’s blood dripped on the white sheet, because Aria refused to drink it. She looked at him with disdain in her eyes, but her eyes would flicker back to the blood every other second. She was on the verge of giving up and taking up his offer, but then, she was always a stubborn woman to begin with. 
In a corner of this hut, Letto curled himself, as he watched the whole exchange. He tried not to attract too much attention to himself, as he observed silently. 
"Explain to me!" Aria roared, she hurt her throat, but she couldn’t care less. Her whole body was shaking, she fought the urge to give up. "Why am I still alive?!" 
"I will explain to you later when you have gotten better." That was the only reply that Dexter gave to her question. 
"I want the explanation now!" Aria barked out, but Dexter simply put his palm close to her lips, so she could taste his blood and that was all it needed to make her give in and start sucking out his blood hungrily. 
The look of it was so painful and horrendous, Letto grimaced and winched when he heard the sound of blood- sucking noise made by Aria, but all Dexter did was simply caress her back and coo softly at her. 
"Slowly," he said.

Yet, Cane was so cold and callous, which scared the poor girl. She tried to make an advance and please him like the King and her father wanted her to, but one deadly look from him was enough to scare her out of her mind. 
Cane looked like he was in a bad mood and he didn’t stay longer than necessary. The King invited him to talk about the recent issues in the morning court and after that, he left. His excuse held the water because he had been on an arduous journey for weeks, thus he needed to rest.

###Chapter 217: MORNING DISTURBANCE
Chapter 217: MORNING DISTURBANCE
Iris woke up the next morning and found herself alone. She looked at the spot beside her and knew Cane had slept there last night because that side was slightly unkempt, but it seemed he left very early in the morning. 
Iris couldn’t recall his presence, because she slept throughout the night and didn’t wake up at all. She was very tired after their long journey and had seemingly passed out the moment her head hit the pillow and felt the comfort of the bed after weeks of sleeping inside the shaking carriage.

Her face looked ecstatic to see Iris was up, as she giggled when she saw her hair. It almost looked like a lion’s mane, as it framed her tiny face.

Because Hanna was the personal maid for Iris, thus all the rundown was given to her by the head servant from the palace. 
The ceremony would be held two weeks from now and since tonight was a monumental event of the year, needless to say, there would be a big party to celebrate it, where the palace would open their gates to greet the commoners. This occasion only happens once a year.

But, it was so different with Iris, hearing there would be a lot of people and even commoners inside the palace, only made her even more nervous. 
"Don’t worry, I will be with you," Hanna reassured her, as if she could smell her anxiety had increased. 
Iris didn’t say anything and let Hanna take care of her hair, while she had her breakfast. She also chose the best dress for her to go out, because right now she was the Luna of the Blue Moon pack and also the mate of the Alpha from the Howling Wolf pack. She needed to be presentable in front of all the people. 
Iris was wearing a white dress with golden lace on its hem and its high collared neck, coupled with a fur cloak in the same color, while her hair cascaded down behind her back with half of it tied up into a bun above her head. 
Hanna was delighted that she didn’t forget to bring this dress and managed to stuff it inside their luggage. 
Wearing this color, Iris looked regal and innocent at the same time, people who didn’t know her would think she was a princess from a great kingdom. There was something about her that gave off the feeling of serenity, as if there was nothing that could bother her. 
With Hanna, she walked down the corridor to go to the east palace, where they would see the seamstress to try on a few dresses. 
But, when they were about to enter the carriage that would take them to the east palace, someone approached them. 
It was Hanna, who heard his greeting, while Iris noticed it because she stopped talking and turned her head to bow respectfully to the person that came to them. 
It was Lou. He was wearing his favorite red cloak with a different design this time, which made him look carefree and as if the cold wind couldn’t bother him at all. 
"Long time no see red hair," Lou greeted Iris, which made Hanna frown, this man shouldn’t have greeted her missy that way. She was the Luna of two packs. 
However, she didn’t dare to correct him, because even Iris didn’t say anything about it. 
Since she saw the strange dark wisp emerging from Cane’s palm, she completely forgot about Lou’s existence. 
"It’s great to see you, you look so gorgeous in that dress," Lou complimented her.

"Let’s go, I will go with you, because I need to discuss some business with Princess Osana. You don’t mind if I go with you, right?" 
Despite the question, Lou had opened the carriage door for Iris and offered his hand to help her to get into the carriage, like a gentleman. 
The east palace was the same palace where Princess Osana lived, thus Lou’s excuse made sense.

###Chapter 218: IMPORTANT THING
Chapter 218: IMPORTANT THING

###Chapter 221: THAT WAS NOT HER BLOOD

Nala knew this merchant was a little bit... out of ordinary, but his sense of humor was something that she couldn’t comprehend at all. His jokes could be so dark and he would say them with a straight face, which would make the other people think he was serious about what he was saying. 
"How can I take that as a joke? Who would make jokes like that?" Nala felt her heart almost stop beating. 
"I would." 
Nala took a deep breath and stared at the little bottle in Lou’s hand, which he played between his fingers. "What is that?" 
"Hair tonic," Lou replied nonchalantly, as he leaned his back against the pillow and raised the bottle in his hand, as the light from the luminous pearls glinted off of it. 
"Lou!" 
"For your breasts. So, they will get bigger. They are too small for my liking." 
"Lou!" Nala felt so embarrassed. No one had ever talked like that about her.
Finally, Lou shifted his attention toward Nala and tilted his head, as he dropped the bottle back into her hands. He looked lazy and bored. "This is for your scar. This is very expensive, so if you break it, I will send you to a brothel to work in order to pay me back. Don’t throw it away again." 
Nala looked so hurt with the way Lou threatened her, but it was not something that she couldn’t endure. She had gone through worse and if she could say, the way she lived in the palace was no different from a brothel. The only difference was; the men there were of high status, but their morale was on the same level as those men, who came to the brothels. 
That was why Nala was genuinely attracted to Alpha Cane. Despite her mission from the King, she really wanted to know why the Alpha didn’t even take a second glance at her or any other woman. 
However, when she heard Alpha Cane got another woman pregnant, she started to think that man was not as loyal as she thought he would be. 
"I don’t want to wear that red cloak, I want the other red one," Lou said and then pushed the chest back to Nala, telling her to put it back where she picked it up. "Don’t make a noise, I want to sleep." 
Lou turned his back to her and closed his eyes, still naked. His skin was so pale for a man, as if he had never been exposed to the sunlight for too long. Without the cloak, he was actually quite skinny for a man and had no muscles, since he was not a shifter and didn’t do physical labor. 
However, surprisingly, he was pretty strong despite his appearance, Nala couldn’t even get away when he held both of her hands down by using only one hand. 
"But, all of your cloaks are red," Nala said, yet received no answer. He must have fallen asleep. 
Sighing, Nala took the chest and put it back on the table. It was so heavy! And then stared at the little bottle with the ominous liquid, she opened the lid and smelled it. 
She scrunched her nose because the smell was so strong and she was still suspicious this was poison. 
But then, Lou spoke casually. "That’s not for you to drink, you need to apply it on your scar. Don’t drink it if you don’t want to die." 
Now Nala was speechless. Why wouldn’t he say it earlier? What if she had tasted it? This merchant was too much!

"Are you sleeping?" Sofia asked Redmond in a small voice. It was in the middle of the night and she couldn’t fall asleep, because her back was literally killing her. 
Before when it happened, Redmond would press a hot towel against her lower back and it helped, though his nonstop complaints would give her a headache, she thought she could endure his rambling. 
"What do you want?" Redmond asked, he didn’t even open his eyes, as he turned his body to the other side. He had been sleeping on the couch every night and refused to sleep on the same bed with Sofia when she suggested it. 
’I am used to moving around so much in my sleep, I don’t want to kill the baby in case I hit and kick your stomach by chance.’ 
That was what Redmond said while grumbling about how uncomfortable the couch was. 
"My back is in pain again, can you help me?" Sofia asked, grimacing because she was having a hard time doing anything the bigger her stomach got. She got tired so easily and this was so frustrating. "Redmond..." she nudged his arm. "I can’t reach my back..." 
"Why are you so annoying?!" Redmond glowered, but he actually got up and went to the kitchen to boil water. 
Seeing that, Sofia bit her lips to prevent herself from smiling. She was still in denial that the baby in her stomach was not the Alpha’s, but recently, she didn’t to the idea of Redmond being the man who slept with her that night. 
This man was so harsh and every time he spoke, he was either grumbling or saying something annoying, but he would find a way to make her feel better and help her with this pregnancy, even though he found this troublesome. 
Redmond was not an alpha and was a mere warrior from the Blue Moon pack, but even at his worst, he was way nicer and more helpful than Alpha Gallot had ever been. 
Back in the Moon Dew pack, once a mistress got pregnant, the Alpha would stop visiting them, since he couldn’t get physical with them, Alpha Gallot would only come when they gave birth. If it was a son, he would probably spend some time with the baby, but if it was a girl, he wouldn’t care much, until they were five or six years old, where he could play father with them. 
"Take off your dress," Redmond said harshly, as he held the warm towel in his hand. 
"You can ask me nicely, you know." Sofia’s smile fell, but she took off her dress in front of him, which made him groan. 
"Damn it! Why is there no brothel here?" Redmond grumbled. "You should ask Maria to sleep over and help you with this, I am not comfortable seeing you all naked." 
"What? A naked pregnant woman makes you uncomfortable?" Sofia hated it when he mentioned going to a brothel. 
"Because I am horny!" Redmond carped. 
Because the pack didn’t have any brothels, he couldn’t vent his frustrations and Jace had been keeping his eyes on him and deflecting his moves whenever he tried to get one of the Howling Wolf pack’s women to his bed. 
Redmond couldn’t comprehend how those men could stay celibate for such a long time. Was there something wrong with their minds?

"You killed Mason," Cane stated lightly, as he traced his fingers mindlessly on her back. 
Both of them were lying on the bed, savoring this moment without saying anything, but it was already enough. They felt content by only being so close to each other, as if their hearts could be in peace no matter how chaotic the world would be tomorrow. 
Iris didn’t answer that, but she buried her face in his chest, feeling guilty for some reason. 
"Did you kill him by killing his wolf spirit?" From the information Cane gathered from Grace, it was a sudden death. The external injuries were not the cause of it. It was almost like he simply met his demise naturally. 
Iris still didn’t say anything, she curled her body, as if by doing so, Cane wouldn’t notice her there, but her silence was a solid answer for Cane. 
However, when Cane didn’t say anything anymore, Iris lifted her head and stared at him. "Are you upset that I killed him?" 
Cane shook his head. "Why would I be?" 
"You kept him alive for a reason..." Iris thought there was a reason why Cane kept Mason alive, probably there was a secret or some question that he wanted to ask him, but she ruined it. 
"I kept him alive because I don’t want him to have an easy death. I hope you made his death so painful. Death is an easy way out for someone like him," Cane said truthfully. 
Iris thought about that for a while. "I wish I didn’t kill him right away..." she muttered under her breath and this made Cane chuckle. "What?" 
"I have never thought that I will have a discussion about killing someone with you one day." Cane pulled Iris closer, as if he wanted to be one with her. "I can’t even say this is progress." 
"Is it bothering you that I killed someone?" Iris killed Jemma indirectly by letting Will deliver the punishment, but with Mason, it was different. She killed him with her own hands. 
"No." Cane stared into her deep blue eyes. She was genuinely worried about the way he perceived her. "I am glad you can make your own call and it doesn’t bother you as much." 
As much as Cane wanted Iris to stay pure and na?ve, he knew it wouldn’t do any good for them in the long run. In a way, he felt like he had corrupted her. 
"Cane... actually..." Iris tried to find the right words to tell him about her feelings. "I felt a little bit... satisfied when I killed him. I felt liberated... Is it normal for me to feel this way? I even went ahead and thought of doing something horrendous to Kellan as well," Iris admitted, feeling a bit shameful.
###Chapter 544: THE CHAOTIC MORNING
Chapter 544: THE CHAOTIC MORNING
"Is it wrong for me to think like that?" Iris asked him, staring at her mate. She was afraid he would see her differently, yet Cane didn’t seem to be bothered by her revelation at all as he caressed her head lovingly. 
"I too used to wish for a few horrendous things to happen to my enemies, Iris. Do you think it’s wrong for me to think of hurting people who have hurt me?" Cane asked her back, knowing what was in her mind. Iris had always been the one to talk about her feelings and what was on her mind and she set an example for Cane that it was alright to be vulnerable with each other. 
"No..." Iris replied after some contemplation. 
"Then there is nothing wrong with you, Iris. We are living beings with a lot of emotions, not some puppets without any feelings. Hatred, love, jealousy and whatnot, they are all just part of the fact that we feel something and that’s a good thing." Cane leaned over and kissed her lips. He nibbled a little bit longer, and Iris liked it when he kissed her and he did it often these days. "You need to start worrying if you don’t feel anything and it will be even stranger if you don’t hate people, who have hurt you to such an extent." 
Iris pulled away and stared at Cane, her expression was serious, but she looked adorable in his eyes. "Don’t you think I became a little bit... evil?" 
Cane chuckled. "I still remember what you said."
"What?" Iris tilted her head. 
"’Being close to such a dark influence, blackens me too.’" Cane quoted the thing she said in the past and it surprised Iris that he still remembered it. "If you became a little bit evil, then it must be because I am the one who rubbed it on you." 
Iris scrunched her nose, but she felt easier now that she talked with him. Cane always found a way to make her feel better, whether it was through his actions or words. 
"Sleep, Iris. We have a long journey tomorrow." Cane pressed Iris’ head against his own chest and hugged her to sleep. 
Iris snuggled closer to him. No matter how close they were, it felt like it was not enough. They wanted to be closer than this. 
A small smile tugged the corners of Iris’ lips up, as she heard how strong Cane’s heart was beating. She felt so blissful to be able to hear that, as the sound of it lulled her to sleep. 
The night went quietly and when the morning came, the first thing Iris saw was Aliana, who was smiling at her playfully. 
"Good morning!" She said loudly, which made Iris frown and stare at the other side of the bed, but Cane was long gone. "The Alpha was up two hours back and he said to let you sleep, not to wake you up." 
Iris rubbed her eyes and yawned. "You have been here for two hours?" 
"Yes. The Alpha asked someone to wake me up very early in the morning," Aliana grimaced, she felt like Cane did that as a punishment for taking Iris to the tavern, though it was pretty mild compared to what the others got. 
"What did you do for two hours?" Iris widened her eyes. She felt a little bit off to know someone stared at her while she was sleeping. 
"Trying not to fall asleep," Aliana replied bitterly. 
Meanwhile, Cane was in his study room. He needed to take care of a few things before he left for the Silver River pack. Because there were so many warriors that had died during the battle, he had arranged for the warriors from the Riverside pack to stay back in the Howling Wolf pack and help guard the territory. 
Somehow, there was no monster attack and it was probably because of the lycan. 
Cane figured out the lycan could control the monsters, but then he still couldn’t understand why there was a monster attack during one of the new moons when they were still in the Blue Moon pack, where it could put Iris in grave danger and why the lycan did not simply command the monsters to back off. 
Lu didn’t talk to him anymore, he went back to lying dormant and refused to say anything, unless he let him out, which would never happen if it was up to Cane to decide. 
There was a knock on the door and Cane told the other person to enter the room. It was Jace with a young girl around the age of seventeen. She looked flustered and wary to be in the presence of the Alpha. 
"G- good morning, Alpha," Carla said in a small voice, she didn’t dare to look the Alpha in the eyes, because of how domineering he was. 
"Is that the girl you mentioned before?" Cane asked Jace. 
"Yes. She is young, but she is a quick learner, she used to work under Aliana and take care of the orphanage," Jace replied. There was this slight frown between his brows when he spoke again. "Are you sure you are going to do this?" 
Cane didn’t answer that question, but instead he gave an order. "Bring Kaz here." 
It didn’t take long before the head steward entered the study room. He looked a little bit better, though he was still trying to wrap his head around the idea that it was actually the Luna who had asked for his freedom and not the Alpha, who had forgiven him. 
"Alpha..." Kaz called Cane politely, he had his head hung low, but he glanced at Carla. What was she doing here? 
People knew Carla as someone who had worked with Aliana in the orphanage, but aside from that, they didn’t really know this young girl, as she didn’t really socialize with people in the pack house. 
Carla had a small and round face with her black hair tied up into a simple bun on top of her head. She had freckles on her nose and cheeks, which made her look lovely. 
"I don’t have time for a long explanation." Cane started, he stood up from his seat and walked toward them. He stared at Kaz and the head steward lowered his head even more, afraid. There was something different with the way Cane looked at him. 
The Alpha almost felt like he was suppressing his wrath. 
"Kaz, you are going to teach Carla everything that you know about your job and after six months, you can retire. Jace will supervise the progress and I hope you will not mess this one up. This will be my last order for you." 
Kaz and Carla were shocked to hear the decision, but Kaz was the one who wailed his complaint. "Alpha! I still can work for another decade! Why do you want me to retire?!" 
Cane raised his hand to tell Kaz to stop complaining before directing his gaze toward Carla. Kaz wanted to intervene and continue voicing his grievances, but he didn’t dare. 
"Will you take the responsibility and learn quickly how to take care of the pack house?" 
It shouldn’t be hard for Carla to learn how to take care of the pack house since she used to take care of the orphanage. 
"Yes, Alpha," Carla replied hastily. She was not sure if she had a choice to say ’no’, but agreeing with the Alpha was the right thing to do at this moment. More so, how could she turn down a direct order from the Alpha when she didn’t even have the courage to look him in the eyes? It would be a wonder she could stand without trembling in his presence one day. 
"Good." Cane nodded. "Jace, you can show her her room in the pack house." 
Now that the orphanage was being managed by Hanna and Will, Carla could fill another role to contribute to the pack. More so, it was some kind of promotion for her to be able to manage the pack house, despite her young age. 
"Come with me," Jace said to Carla, leaving Cane and Kaz alone. 
"Alpha, can you tell me what I have done so wrong until you want to kick me aside?" Kaz had tears in his eyes when he spoke, his voice was hoarse and he felt like someone just punched him in the gut. 
"I am not kicking you aside, I have a nice house outside of the pack house prepared for you." Cane walked toward Kaz. "I thank you for what you have done for the pack, but it’s time you quit." 
"Alpha!" Kaz fell to the ground. He had been taking care of the pack house for almost his whole life and it was something he was proud of, this was part of his life, thus when it was taken from him and he needed to live by letting someone fill his role, the feeling was way worse than when the Alpha sent him to spend his days in the dungeon. "If this is about something that I have done to Luna Iris, I will apologize to her. I will make it up to her. I will do anything to make her comfortable!" 
Cane stared at Kaz, while he rambled about all the right things he was going to do, but the more he didn’t get any reaction, the more he realized, it was a futile attempt to convince the Alpha to change his decision. 
"You disappointed me so much, Kaz, to the point I don’t want to look at you," Cane finally spoke, once Kaz stopped and his words were akin to a dagger that seared his heart deeply.

"You disappointed me so much, Kaz, to the point I don’t want to look at you," Cane finally spoke, once Kaz stopped and his words were akin to a dagger that seared his heart deeply. "Should I start with the way you talk to her? Or should I start with the way you rally people behind you to create a hateful image about my mate?" Cane’s figure towered above Kaz’s right now and the old steward looked so dreadful, as the Alpha’s domineering nature overwhelmed him. "That’s an act of betrayal, Kaz." 
Hearing that, Kaz shook his head vigorously, feeling very dreadful when Cane saw it in such a way. "I will never do something like that, Alpha! I will never betray you!" 
Cane didn’t answer that, he let him ramble again, explaining things incoherently. He just waited for him to stop before he spoke with finality, because he knew there was no end to this conversation and even if he pointed out all the things that he had done wrong, Kaz would never see his errors, since he didn’t see himself in the wrong, so it was just a futile conversation in the end. 
"Iris is the Luna of the pack and she is my mate, my equal. The offenses you committed against her are the same as you offending me and you feel no remorse for that, Kaz." 
"Alpha..." Kaz looked so pitiful. "I can’t. I can’t see her that way... she is Gerald’s daughter and I can’t see her without being reminded of what her father had done to us!" Kaz said with bitterness. 
"Even after everything she had done for us?" 
"I know, it’s so wrong to hold her accountable for what her father has done, but... I still can’t accept Gerald’s daughter as the Luna of the pack..." Kaz admitted it openly. The pain of their slavery had engraved too deep inside him and it was hard for him to let it go. 
Every time he saw Iris, he felt like he saw Gerald guffawing at them for taking his blood as the Luna of the pack, even after the fall of the Blue Moon pack. This was something that Kaz couldn’t accept. 
That was why when Sofia came claiming she was pregnant with the Alpha’s child, he welcomed her with open arms, no questions asked. 
"That’s more than enough a reason why I don’t want you to be around anymore, Kaz. You are full of hatred and it didn’t help that you spread hatred among the people to go against my luna." 
Kaz lowered his head, he felt so bitter with the way Cane defended Iris. 
"Teach Carla everything and then retire, Kaz. Enjoy your time. This will be my last order." 
Being abandoned like this was even worse than being subjected to torture for Kaz. "Alpha, what do you see in her? She didn’t have anything to give to you, aside from the Blue Moon pack." Kaz gritted his teeth and balled his fists when he spoke again. "She can’t even produce an heir for you after almost a year of being together. Her runt body must not able to carry a child." 
The moment Kaz finished his words, he wailed in pain, as he held the right side of his face, where blood dripped from the wounds on his cheek. 
The pain rendered him speechless, but what shocked him even more was the fact Cane had just attacked him. The Alpha had just clawed his face and this rattled him to the bone. The Alpha actually attacked him! 
He would have never thought, the Alpha would hurt him and attack him as if he was an enemy. 
"Kaz, I will not tolerate anyone who talks trash about my mate. Not even you." Cane narrowed his eyes dangerously, as an unadulterated murderous aura exuded from his body. "You should know better than to test my limits." 
His eyes were so vicious and fathomless, as if you could be swallowed into the darkness if you stared a bit too long. 
Cane was trying to suppress his killing intent, but even so, Kaz was still able to feel it and this shook him to the core. 
"Al- alpha..." Kaz wailed. Instinctively, he moved away from Cane, afraid for his life. 
"Leave, Kaz. This will be the last time I see you." Cane’s voice was so deep and his whole body was trembling. It was so rare to see him so angry, and even more scarce for him to attack his own people, especially someone as old as Kaz, who definitely couldn’t defend himself if the Alpha really wanted to kill him. 
Kaz had tears in his eyes when he stood up, his wounds had healed, leaving only a trace of blood on his face, but his heart ached so badly with the way he was being treated. 
Yet, as a matter of fact, there was no middle ground for this matter when the old steward refused to own up to his mistakes and see how he was in the wrong. 
That would be a pointless argument and Cane didn’t have any desire to waste his time with him. 
It was a pity that the relationship between them had to end on a bad note, but then Cane wouldn’t have trouble sleeping knowing Kaz deserved it. What he said and also the way he treated his mate was way worse than getting a mere claw on the face. What Kaz did cut Iris so deep and it was Cane’s fault not to see it until it was too late. 
As Cane tried to control his anger, the flashes of Iris’ outburst that day resurfaced in his mind, he could feel the rage of the lycan as well to see how upset and helpless she was.

Chapter 546: THE TRAITOR
Lil Thing had been roaming around the pack and would end up at the orphanage frequently, where he would then be taken into custody by the children there, as they loved it. Of course, the furball couldn’t shake them off and ended up as their plaything. 
Meanwhile, its owner didn’t really care about it.

"It’s okay," Iris said, as she walked forward when Zephyr tried to shield her from Lil Thing. She extended her hand and caressed its head, as it whined against her touch, as if complaining. 
Even though it was proven that Lil Thing was harmless to children, Zephyr had witnessed the feral side of this white furball, so out of instinct and duty, he needed to step forward and protect Iris. 
"It’s okay, that furry creature is fine," Eron said to Zephyr, as he handed over another chest for him to put inside the carriage. "The one you need to pay close attention to is that merchant." 
The Alpha had emphasized to not let Iris engage with the sorcerer as much as possible. 
"It is so hard to find a way to talk with you," Lou complained, as he approached Iris and pushed the white bear aside. "I heard you drank a few nights ago, do you want to try drinking in broad daylight?" Lou had this brilliant smile on his lips, as he made a bold offer. 
Of course, hearing this, the seven warriors immediately jumped in to interrupt. They still remembered their punishment to chase after the monsters in the Goffa mountain and now they didn’t want to imagine what else their alpha would do to them if they let this happen.

"Luna, have you met the horses that will pull your carriage? Come, I will introduce you to them." 
They tried to use all the excuses they could think to get Iris away from the merchant, even though some of them sounded very ridiculous.

"Is it not enough?" Nolu asked. "Can you stay for two to three days more? It’s nice to have all of you here. People said, they are happy to serve all of you. Me too." 
Seeing how Iris was too caught up in her emotions, Aliana stepped forward. She caressed his head and put back the money into his pocket.

Candy was something they were not privileged to eat. Something they needed to steal from the higher ranking members if they really wanted to have a taste of it. Sweet things were forbidden to those lowborns, they were too expensive for them. 
Nolu’s face lit up to see a lot of candies, but he was still hesitant to leave. He stared at the Luna, who became so quiet.

The atmosphere around them became very bleak. 
"Luna, we need to go," Aliana reminded Iris. 
"This is not right," Iris finally spoke, she blinked her eyes and pressed her lips tightly. "We shouldn’t give up on them." 
They had been here for a little more than a week. It was a short period of time to discover any potential of this pack. They should try harder, right? Just because some group of ignorant shifters were against them, they shouldn’t abandon those who really needed their help. 
"I know what you feel. But, this matter has been discussed and the decision has been made." Aliana tried to remind Iris that they had weighed this decision carefully. 
If they chose to help this pack, while those mutineers were still against them, there was only one option left for them; oppressing those Silver Warriors, which would lead to a battle, it was something that couldn’t be avoided. 
And in battles, people tended to die, it was either their people or them. 
Putting that matter aside, there was another problem with the members of the pack. Since, they couldn’t find any benefits in this pack, it meant, there was no contribution whatsoever. If they insisted on taking this pack into their territory, it meant they needed to feed thousands of more people. 
Famine was a problem now, not to mention winter was just in the corner, with an additional horde of people that needed to be fed, while they were still brainstorming how to get more grains for the other packs, would only create another problem, which they didn’t need. 
"We can’t take them, Luna." 
"If we leave, they will die." 
Aliana sighed. She didn’t have the heart to abandon this pack either, she would do everything to help, but the problem was; they needed to look at the bigger picture. 
This situation was like, saving ten people by sacrificing one. 
"They have survived this far, they might survive this one too." There was no certainty. 
"I want to talk with Cane." Iris stood up, she walked toward the front yard hastily to find the Alpha, while the rest of them followed her. 
The seven warriors had conflicted feelings, while they understood their alpha’s decision, they felt bad for this pack. 
Seeing their luna so adamant to help them, they started to wonder; was this how the Luna looked like when she was very stubborn to help them when they were in the slavery? She was going to go against the Alpha’s decision, if she kept questioning and insisting on helping this pack.

"Cane, I want to talk with you," Iris said, once he noticed her. 
Cane stopped his discussion with Ethan and Oliver. "Something bothering you?" The Alpha caressed the wrinkle between her brows with his thumb. 
"We can’t go, we can’t abandon this pack," Iris said hastily. 
"Ridiculous," Oliver muttered under his breath.

"Are you going back at your words?" Laluna hissed. She couldn’t accept how they started the preparation for the coronation when it was not her son, who would sit on the throne. 
And then what? The capital city would be moved here? The south would be the new capital city? 
Laluna rambled about the whole thing that she had been holding back ever since she stayed in this pack. She couldn’t have the two main bedrooms and settled at the guest bedroom, no one really paid attention to her and what she and her baby got was only the bare minimum. 
"The bare minimum?" Iris was actually smiling with this question. "What actually did you expect during the war?" 
"I am the..." 
"...Queen Mother because your son was named heir by the previous king?" Iris finished her sentence, she felt oddly familiar with this antic. 
Oh, right. The people from the Holy Kingdom used to talk in this manner before. No wonder she felt this familiarity. 
"Are you mocking me?" Laluna narrowed her eyes. 
"Yes, I am." 
Iris’s answer caught Laluna off guard, she didn’t think the luna would be this petty. "My son has the royal blood!" 
"Do you think Cane doesn’t have it? Her mother is the true legitimate princess, the next in line for the throne." Iris reminded Laluna, she took a step closer toward her. She was not as tall as her, but somehow Laluna was on guard. She felt intimidated. "Stop this nagging, while I am being nice."
###Chapter 986: WAKE UP, YOU ARE DREAMING
Chapter 986: WAKE UP, YOU ARE DREAMING
"What is the basis of your claim?" Iris narrowed her eyes dangerously at her. She would be able to squeeze her wolf spirit, but she didn’t need to do that. "Because the previous king named him as an heir? That reason is very shallow, don’t you think?" 
Laluna didn’t answer that, she knew it was very shallow. 
"Do you really think you can make your baby as the king without any merit? Do you want to be the queen mother? Do you even know how to rule a kingdom?" 
Iris smiled at Laluna harmlessly. 
"Do you want to take the throne? Good luck with that. Let’s see whether the people will follow your lead." 
Iris was about to leave, but Laluna had not yet done. 
"Don’t you think that you are being too greedy? You wanted to get what is the birthright of my son." Laluna grabbed Iris’s hand to prevent her from leaving, but the luna swatted her hand, but she stayed to listen to her gibberish.

"Greedy?" Iris scoffed. "We lost thousand, no, hundred thousand of people during the war, more than half of this continent was being wiped out because of it." 
Iris gritted her teeth when she recalled all the name of the people that she lost. What kind of brutality that she and all the people had to endure. 
"While we were fighting out there with our lives on the line, you were here, complaining about what? Bedroom? While we were out there, thinking this would be the end of us, here you were, trying to find a way to put your baby on the throne to rule the kingdom that is on the verge of collapse. Do you even know how to feed the people, protect our land, make a plan and what is actually happening right now?"

"After all I have done and all the pain I have gone through, after all the people that I lost in order to kill the enemy... I deserve it. I deserve the title." 
Laluna swallowed so hard, she felt like she was a prey in front of the predator.

The dead people during the war didn’t hold any significant value in her eyes. "If you were the one, who ruled this kingdom. Give it two months and there wouldn’t be a kingdom to be ruled." 
At this point, Laluna didn’t even want to have this argumentation with Iris anymore, she wanted her to stay away from her because she scared her.

It was so fascinating of how little thing like this could warm your heart and made all the pain and tired day became worth it.
###Chapter 987: THE CEREMONY
Chapter 987: THE CEREMONY
Because the actual crowns for the king and the queen had been destroyed during the war and there was nothing left from that period of time, the era of the previous king had been wiped out completely. 
In this case, it meant, Cane would make a new history with his own legacy.

"Yes, I think there is something that you can be grateful for even in the worse time," Iris replied. "But, why are you here?"

Currently, Iris was in the middle of her preparation for the coronation that would happen in three hours from now. 
Iris was wearing a beautiful golden dress that made the color of her hair stood up, this dress was made in hurry with the material that they could find, but it turned out this was very beautiful and it fit her perfectly. 
The dress fell beautifully on her body, its long sleeves covered her arms with little detail and intricacy. The crown was made of gold as well, it was simple, but it served its purposed. Iris and Cane had seen the crown, which they agreed that it was the best, they could modify it later on.

"I came to give my blessing to you." Lou grinned. "I have a gift for you." 
"What is it?" Iris furrowed her brows. He could give the gift later. 
The merchant just randomly appeared in this bedroom with the portal, it seemed, Cane needed to limit the magic stone that was given on him, so he wouldn’t pull this trick again. 
"Put this on your crown, so it will look more pretty," Lou said, he threw something toward Aliana and when she saw, it was a big blue diamond, as big as your thumb. "Where is your crown? I will put it on it."

"Give me back the baby!" Aliana was frustrated, she couldn’t do anything to this merchant because he was holding Zenith. 
"Don’t be too noisy, he is having fun with me." 
Thankfully, it was Zenith, because if it was Zander that Lou picked, the baby must have cried out loud and made a fuss, while Zenith kept silence, but his expression showed how uncomfortable he was. 
"Give me back my baby," Iris finally said. She knew Lou wouldn’t do any harm on her little one, but Aliana looked like she was going to kill this merchant. 
Well, suffice to say, Iris didn’t want bloodshed in her coronation day.

This was only the foundation of Cane’s new rules, the rest would follow in his reign. 
A few men didn’t happy with this, but the rest of them were fine, while the women were happy with these new rules! 
After the ceremony, there was a huge festivity to celebrate their new king and queen, everyone cheered for them and the night was lively. 
All of them looked forward to their reign.
###Chapter 988: HE IS MINE
Chapter 988: HE IS MINE

###Chapter 989: BONUS - : FIRST STEP
Chapter 989: BONUS Chapter: FIRST STEP
The weather was nice, the sky was clear and the wind was not too harsh. It was a perfect time for a picnic and this little family planned to do so. 
But, before that, they would use this time to visit an important place first. 
They had visited this time a few months ago when the reconstruction on this site started, but they had not yet seen the result. 
There were so many things that happened during the past few months and they were busy with a lot of things that piled up in order to preserve this new reign of theirs. 
Therefore, today was an exceptional day where they could enjoy their time together. 
Cane, Iris and their babies rode a carriage to go to Goffa mountain, where they had done with the construction of the burial place.

Chrystal and Rora Nortern.

The twins were ten months old now and they started to talk more, though Zenith was not as active and talkative like his twin. 
They stayed there for an hour, there was no word that exchanged, but the quietness was peaceful. They were reminiscing their hard time and how they were thriving to survive. Their hope to see a better day, their wish to give a better place for their children...

He took two steps and then fell, but he got up and then took four steps before he fell again.

###Chapter 990: BONUS - : MISSING

"We will be in a lot of trouble," Zenith said in low voice, he warned his twin brother, who looked very excited. If he was in this high spirited mood, no one would be able to talk sense into his thick head. 
"Don’t worry! I have thought about that, that’s why we bring Zaya with us!" Zander hugged Zaya. Their little sister just turned five now. "Father will not punish us harshly because he will punish Za too. Father will not have a heart to punish our cute little sister." 
People could tell that Zaya had the king wrapped around her little fingers and Cane had soft spot for her. Her twin brothers loved her so much too, but they used to use her as a shield, every time they got into trouble, especially Zander and Zaya loved her brother so much to let them be punished properly. 
"You will put her into trouble." 
"She will be our shield against father’s rage." 
"What about not make him angry in the first place." Zenith then glanced at Lou. They were currently hiding behind the bushes. "Uncle Lou will chew us out." 
Zander waved his hand to dismissed his concern. "I heard he is going to the east, they built this new city there and from what I heard there are a lot of food and amusement, people from Karam and Andelus Continent gathered there to do business and uncle Lou will go there to inspect the space." 
"We can ask father to take us there." 
"I want to try the portal." 
"We have tried it before." 
"But Za have not." Zander then shifted his attention toward his little sister. "Right Za?" 
"I want to try it too," Zaya parroted what Zander said and she got a tight hug from her brother. 
"That’s my sister!" Zander kissed her cheek and she giggled, but he reminded her to be quiet, because right now Lou was going to create a portal to go to the east. 
Lou used to create a portal in the same spot, that’s why Zander knew where to go and when the merchant entered the portal, usually it would stay open for another five seconds, that was the time for them to sneak in and follow him. 
"Let’s go now!" Zander said, he picked up Zaya and carried her in his arms, so Zenith couldn’t do anything. 
Zenith planned to keep Zaya and let Zander went alone, but his twin brother seemed to read his plan and he took the precaution. 
Therefore, Zenith didn’t have any other choice, but to follow his crazy plan. This was not the first time he did this though... 
More so, Zaya looked happy with this new adventure. Not like what people thought of this little girl, where they expected her to be a timid and shy child like her mother, as it turned out, she was as mischievous as her two older brothers. 
One time their mother said that she felt like she had three sons instead. 
"Woah! This is amazing!" Zander was fascinated by the sight before his eyes. There were a lot of big houses being built and so many people from different continent. You would be able to tell from the way they dressed and what was more important was; they could smell a lot of delicious scent in the air. 
The snacks sold in the stalls also looked very appetizing. 
Even Zenith had to admit he was mesmerized by the sight. This was very different from the capital city, where everything looked very classic and rather ancient. 
"Zan, I want that..." Zaya said, she pointed her finger at the red candy sold at one of the stalls. "Zan, I want that." 
Zander grimaced. "But, I don’t bring money." 
Zenith lost it, he covered Zaya’s ears, so she wouldn’t hear him cursing at Zander. "How can you not bring any money with you when you were the one, who suggested to go to this place?" He was in disbelief with his brother’s recklessness. 
"Eleven years old kid doesn’t bring money around, okay." 
However, the three of them startled when they felt this strong aura from behind them, as if they were prey and was being hunted. 
"What the hell are you doing here?!" Lou didn’t believe with what he was seeing. 
He heard their squabble and he thought he only misheard it, but decided to check because he also heard Zaya’s voice. He wouldn’t put pass them that they followed him here, especially Zander and Zenith, the two of them were on their rebellious state and had been acting out often lately. 
"Uncle Lou!" Zaya called him sweetly, she raised both of her arms, her blue eyes shone brightly and under the sunlight, her auburn hair made her look like she was on fire. "Uncle Lou, up! Up!" 
The little girl asked him to be picked up with her sweet smile, how could Lou have a heart to refuse her? 
Begrudgingly Lou picked Zaya up from Zander’s arms and continued to scold the two of them. "Do you even know what you are doing?! You even bring your little sister here!" 
Zander and Zenith lowered their head. The third person that they were scared of aside from their mother and father was this uncle. 
But obviously, it didn’t stop them from doing what they did now. Lou wondered where they got all this curiosity that led them into trouble. 
"Your father is going to kill you when he learned about this, especially if he knew you got your sister involved in this!" Lou felt his head was spinning. Cane might hang him as well. He was very protective of his daughter, more than he did to his mate now. Well, to be fair, Iris was more than capable to protect herself. "Do you know what you are doing?!" 
Zenith still kept his head low, but he glared at his twin brother, while Zander didn’t make a peep. 
It was Zaya, who spoke for them. "Uncle, you scared Za. Don’t be angry, okay?" A kiss landed on Lou’s cheek. "Za wanted to go, Zan said there are a lot of delicious food here." 
"Knowing your father, he will definitely deliver a dozen carriages if you really wanted something, Za. You only need to ask him." 
"But, Za missed uncle. Za wanted to go on trip with uncle Lou." Zaya hugged Lou’s neck and gave his other cheek a kiss as well, which rendered the merchant speechless. "Uncle, uncle, Za wanted that candy." She pointed the candy that she wanted earlier. 
In the end, Lou relented. "I will save my energy to scold you, because your father will do it later." He then walked toward the stall and bought the three of them the candy. 
"See? I told you, Zaya is the best. If she was with us, there is nothing we need to be worried about." Zander smirked smugly at Zenith and then patted his shoulder, as if he was an old person. "Stop frowning and enjoy this trip before we faced our father’s wrath." 
Zander was too carefree and sometime, Zenith felt like to smack his head, but more importantly, he wondered how could he always get involved with Zander’s plan, even though he didn’t want it. 
In the end, Lou had to bring the three children in his meeting with the merchant from Karam continent. 
And when they returned, just like they had predicted, they met with the livid king and queen. Lou had a second thought to create a portal and flee from there, but he remembered the magic stone with him was not enough, or else, he would have sent them back right away. 
He was going to miss his meeting if he had to send them back first and get more magic stone after. 
"Hey! Don’t be mad with me! Not my fault! Not my fault!" Lou immediately explained the situation quickly. 
"Daddy!" Zaya wriggled her body from Lou’s arms and rushed toward her father, but Cane didn’t pick her up. "Daddy? Daddy is angry?" Zaya pursed her lips. 
"Go back with your mother," Cane said. He knew that he wouldn’t be able to get to his sons with Zaya was there. 
Iris immediately picked Zaya up and scolded her, as she walked back to the pack house. Lou tailed behind her, he exclaimed that he didn’t bring them intentionally. He didn’t want to get scolded by the king too. 
"You are in a grief trouble, sons." Cane’s voice was hard and commanded their full attention, making them realized how big of trouble they got themselves into, especially without Zaya there to appease their father’s rage. 
As the punishment, the two of them would get into more training and learned the state affair sooner, which made Zander and Zenith groaned in frustration, because they didn’t like it, since it would cut off their play time. 
Meanwhile, for Zaya, she was not allowed to go out for a day, but Lil Thing would accompany her to play. 
"Daddy, mommy, I am sorry..." Zaya apologized and it melted Cane and Iris’s heart. "Can I go out to play." She looked at them with her big, innocent eyes. 
"No." Cane and Iris replied at the same time firmly. She couldn’t get away with everything by acting cute. 
One night, Zander approached his father. "Should I learn about all of these?" He was fed up. 
"Yes. You are going to be responsible to a lot of people’s lives." 
"I don’t think I will be a good king like you," Zander sounded dejected. 
Cane caressed his head. "I don’t think I am a good king too."
###Chapter 998: BONUS - : AFTER A LONG JOURNEY
Chapter 998: BONUS Chapter: AFTER A LONG JOURNEY
"Mama! Mama! Mama!" Zaya ran in the corridor hastily, her curly, long, auburn hair was tied into a high ponytail. Her cloak fluttered around her ankle, as out there the sky was so bleak, though it was afternoon. Winter was here and Zander and Zenith’s sixteen birthday would come in a few months. 
Iris turned her body around when she heard Zaya’s urgent voice, she sounded like she was going to cry. 
Currently, Iris was with Aliana, talking about the problem with the foodstuff. There was nothing major, this was annual matter, since the winter was here. 
"Mama! You need to see Lil Thing!" Zaya cried by the time she reached her mother, she tugged her hand to follow her. 
"What happened?" Iris frowned. 
"I think Lil Thing is sick," Zale said, he was Zaya’s personal warrior now. He grew up into a fine man and even though he still used to run his mouth as he pleased, he had toned it down now and looked calmer. "The bear is making weird sound." 
Iris immediately rushed with Zaya and Zale, while Aliana came with them as well. 
"Mama... what happened with Lil Thing?" Zaya cried, she hugged Aliana, while Iris checked on the bear. It had been a while, since the bear was too lazy to move, but then Lil Thing was always like that, thus they didn’t notice anything strange with it. 
"Don’t worry, honey," Iris said in her reassuring tone. "Lil Thing only sick, it will be fine." 
Zaya let go of Aliana and approached Lil Thing, she hugged the white bear and cried. Lil Thing stopped making that weird noise after Iris checked on it, but the bear still looked lethargic. 
"I will ask Penny to make a concoction, okay? It will help Lil Thing to feel better." Iris wiped Zaya’s tears, as she nodded and hugged Lil Thing. 
Iris caressed Lil Thing’s head, scratched his single ear and the bear opened its eyes to look at her. there was this complicated feeling that reflected in the queen’s eyes. After that, she went out with Aliana, while Zale comforted her little girl. 
"How is Lil Thing?" Aliana asked, because she could see the word that Iris couldn’t say in front of Zaya. 
"Lil Thing is already so old. The aftermath of the war caught up to it." 
"The children will be devastated." Aliana knew how much the three of them loved the bear, Lil Thing was practically their protector when they were little and were there in every milestone. 
Iris felt so bad. No matter how powerful she was, there were still things that she couldn’t prevent. 
When Zander and Zenith learned about Lil Thing, the two of them came to Zaya’s bedroom and spent the whole night to console her. The two of them were very sad as well. 
After that, Zaya practically didn’t go out of her room for days, she tried to nurse Lil Thing with the concoction that Penny made, she read for the bear. 
Iris would come to check on her and Lil Thing too, but there was nothing much she could do aside to alleviate the pain from the poor bear. 
She could heal illness, but she couldn’t prevent death. 
Iris talked about this with Zaya, but she would end up crying and this broke her heart to see her baby girl was being so upset. 
While Cane would come to visit her every night, Zander and Zenith would come every now and then every time they had free time, so did Lou. 
"Uncle, can’t you do something for Lil Thing?" Zaya clung onto Lou’s neck, she hugged the merchant and started crying again. 
"I am sorry, Zaya." Lou caressed her back. "Lil Thing is very old now. He is tired and need to rest." 
"But Lil Thing always sleeps. It barely moved. Lil Thing even lazier than me, why it needs to rest?" 
"Well. You got the point." Lou furrowed his brows. "But, Lil Thing is old already, if Lil Thing were human, it will be as old as Grilla." 
"But, Grilla is still alive." 
The merchant was lost for word. This was why he didn’t like children, they were very noisy, but then if there was time when he had to lay his life for these children, he would do it without hesitation. 
After a month, Lil Thing’s health deteriorated fast and the winter came. From the window, you would be able to see the snowflake and Zaya was reading a story for Lil Thing, she snuggled against it. 
Later that night, Cane came to Zaya’s bedroom after he finished with the matter for the day, just like her brother, she also moved from her childhood bedroom to the room that she chose. 
"Daddy..." Zaya hugged her father, as she cried because Lil Thing didn’t want to eat. Her face turned red and her hair was messy. She didn’t like anyone to touch her hair, only a few people that she allowed to do it. 
And it was obvious that Cane was among them. Zaya found her father’s hand was comforting, as he patted her back. 
"Daddy, Lil Thing keeps sleeping," Zaya sobbed. "I have given it the concoction that Penny made, but it still looks tired." Zaya lifted her head and tears streamed down her face, it hurt the king to see his daughter’s heartbreak. "Can you do something?" 
"Zaya..." Cane called her name gently, he sat her down on his lap and kissed her forehead. "Lil Thing is already old, it needs to rest." 
Iris and the other people had brought this topic to her gently, so she wouldn’t be too shock. 
Zaya shook her head. "No..." Yet, the concept of death was still foreign for her. She had never experienced anyone close to her leave forever, thus it was hard for her to discern it. "Daddy, why people have to die? Why Lil Thing has to die? Can’t it live forever?" 
Cane combed his fingers against her hair and tied up her hair into a simple bun. He stared at her daughter’s sad face and it reminded that little girl that he saw years ago in one of his illusions. That little girl was also crying like her. 
"It’s okay to feel sad, sweety." Cane kissed her cheek. "We can’t keep Lil Thing forever, but it doesn’t mean you are going to lose it."
Zaya hiccuped. She stared at her father, but her tears still fell on her cheeks. "I can’t be with Lil Thing again if it died." 
"Yes," Cane replied and he could see his answer broke her heart, but then he continued. "You and your brother have taken care of Lil Thing for so long. Lil Thing has been your friends all this time, maybe it’s time for your big sister to play with the bear?" 
"Big sister Rora and Chrystal?" Zaya blinked her eyes. She knew that she had two big sisters, who had gone to heaven. 
"Yes." Cane smiled. "I think it’s their turn to take care of Lil Thing." 
Zaya hugged Cane tightly. "But, they didn’t know Lil Thing like I do... I don’t want Lil Thing to go." 
"I know, my love. I don’t want it to go too." Cane hugged her back tightly. He caressed her back gently. 
On the second months of winter, Lil Thing’s body shrunk, it was the size of puppy. Zaya was shocked to see it and immediately rushed to find her mother. 
Thankfully, Lou was also there and he explained to her. 
"It’s okay. Lil Thing is very tired, so it doesn’t have the energy to preserve its chubby size." 
Lou, Iris and Cane came to Zaya’s bedroom to see Lil Thing. It happened once in the past when they were in the middle of the battle and Lil Thing exhausted itself to fight the enemy. 
Lou took off his red cloak and covered Lil Thing’s small body with it. He cradled the bear in his arms. It was like years ago when he found this bear for the first time. 
"That’s why I named it Lil Thing," Lou said, he handed Lil Thing to Zaya, who hugged the bear closely and kissed its muzzle. 
Lil Thing opened its eyes and let out small noises before it closed them and fell asleep again. 
Out there, it started to snow and the wind became colder, as if time was passing slowly. 
Zenith and Zander’s birthday came, but they didn’t celebrate it lavishly like usual. The three of them were not in the right mood for a celebration and wanted to spend their time with Lil Thing. 
It was a bright day, at the end of winter, where the snow was starting to melt and the air was not too cold and the sprouts were starting to grow when Lil Thing breathed its last breath in Iris’ arms. 
Iris tried to preserve the bear’s life, but it had reached its end. 
"Say goodbye to Lil Thing, okay..." Iris said softly to her crying daughter. 
Zander and Zenith came closer, while Cane and Lou stood by the side. There were Ethan, Jace and a few more people inside Zaya’s room. 
"I love you, Lil Thing... my big sisters will take care of you, okay?" Zaya kissed Lil Thing and the bear licked her cheek for the last time. 
The bear was warm and surrounded by the people it loved too. The lazy bear finally rested after a long journey. 
"It’s okay, Za. Rora and Chrystal take care of Lil Thing," Zenith said in his deep voice, as he hugged Zaya tightly and his sister cried against his chest.

The decree was proven to be very effective to stop them from running their mouth wildly. 
How could Cane be thinking of being with another woman aside from the mother of his children, the woman that he chose to be by his side, someone, who gave him an honor to share her time together.

It was almost unbearable to see Cane right now. In the past, he was overly alerted with his surroundings, he had never lowered his guard down, even when he was asleep. 
A simple noise would be able to wake him up, but it was different right now. 
Iris had been trying to wake him up, but he was still fast asleep. If it was not because Cane needed to take his medicine, she wouldn’t have a heart to wake him up as well. 
Even though the medicine didn’t really have any effect, but it would be able to give his body a little bit of strength. 
"Cane..." Iris nuzzled his nose with hers and kissed his lips. "Come, wake up and drink your medicine, after that, you need to eat, only then you can sleep again. Sleepyhead." Iris giggled with the endearment name she called him, but it was an empty laugh. In the past, it would be her, who would easily fall asleep. "Come on, you big bad wolf." 
Cane furrowed his brows, he opened his eyes sleepily and looked at Iris. "Good morning." 
Iris chuckled. "It’s afternoon, love." 
"I missed you." 
"I missed you too." Iris kissed his lips. 
"I have a long dream." 
"I hope it’s a good dream." 
"I don’t know. I don’t remember, but I feel happy." 
Iris smiled at that. Whatever that dream was, as long as it made him happy, it was enough. Iris then helped Cane to drink his medicine and ate his food. 
He didn’t have a good appetite. He ate so little. 
"You ate like a bird," Iris commented and this made Cane smiled. 
"You used to eat like a bird too." 
That was a good day, where Cane remembered everything, but after that, there was a long bad day, where he didn’t remember anything at all. He didn’t even remember himself and spent most of the time sleeping. 
Iris was hopeless, she was no longer be able to cry and withdrawn from the state affair, which now was being handled by their sons, thankfully, there were a lot of people, who helped the twins and they could understand the situation of their parents. 
She prayed that miracle would happen. She spent her night, staring at Cane’s face, because she was afraid if she fell asleep and she woke up to find out he was no longer with her... 
She didn’t want to miss every second she had with him. 
And one day, on a bright beautiful day, when Cane was having his bad time to remember, Lou came. He barged into their bedroom and made a lot of commotion. 
Because everyone knew it was Lou and they were well aware the relationship between their sovereign with this merchant, the guards didn’t really stop him. 
"Iris! Iris!" Lou bounced from the door, until he found her. 
"Lou, you can’t shout here," Iris warned him. 
"This is great! This is really great!" Lou said, he stopped in front of her and then grinned. "Anyway, you look beautiful today." 
Iris rolled her eyes. She was already immune with his antics. 
"What do you want to tell me?" There must be something extremely important that could make Lou act like this. 
But, before he answered her question, Lou shifted his attention toward Cane. "Does he have a bad day?" 
All of them knew what it meant for Cane to have a bad day. 
"Yes." Iris tried to appear tough, but the sadness was palpable in her eyes. 
"Too bad." Lou clicked his tongue. 
"Where have you been?" Iris didn’t want to hear anything about that, currently, Cane was sitting near the window, basking in the warmth of light in the summer afternoon. 
Lou had gone missing for a month now and no one could find out where he was, but Iris knew. He had been moving around all over the continent by the portal he created. She didn’t know what he was doing, but she knew it wouldn’t be something bad. 
Lou would have never gone from the capital city and left the twins if it was not an urgent matter. 
"You may want to consider to kiss me," Lou grinned, but from the corner of his eyes, he could see how Cane gave him a look. Even in his bad day, Cane was still hostile toward him when it came to Iris. 
"Do you want me to kick you out?" Iris narrowed her eyes. She wondered how Lou didn’t change at all. 
Lou raised both of his hands and then looked at Cane. "You need to remember this! I saved your ass!" 
"What is it?" Iris didn’t want to let her hope soared, because she knew exactly what Lou was talking about and why he was beaming like this. "Lou, tell me." 
"I know a way how to save your mate." Lou looked so proud of himself. He crossed his arms and looked very smug. 
And for the first time after such a long time, Iris saw how gorgeous the merchant was. 
"You are not kidding me, right?" 
"You are going to skin me alive if I am joking with you about this matter, Iris." Lou was a jokester and sometime, he didn’t choose his word wisely, but he knew better not to make a joke about this. 
Lou thought he would finally get a kiss or a hug, but Iris actually broke down, crying so hard, which made the merchant panic. 
"Hey! Hey!" Lou immediately knelt down. "I expect a kiss, you know, not a cry. Well, a thank you will do too." 
However, Cane stood up from his sitting position and approached his mate, he didn’t remember her, but he consoled her like he used to like usual, as if his body remembered it. Iris then hugged Cane so tightly, her whole body was trembling. 
"Shouldn’t I be the one, who got a hug?" Lou frowned and then shrugged his shoulders. "Never mind." 
In the end, Lou sat down on the floor, along with the couple, he crossed his legs and played with the hem of his red cloak, waiting until Cane managed to calm Iris down. 
"Are you done crying? Can we talk?" Lou asked in bored tone. He had not yet even explained it to Iris when she broke down crying. "You need to hear my explanation first, this is not an easy task too." 
Iris wiped her tears, she shook her head. "As long as there is a way, it can be done." Cane looked at her, concern in his expression. "I am fine, Cane. I am okay." Iris kissed the tip of his nose. 
Lou clapped his hands to get their attention. "Okay, stop being lovey dovey, listen to me now." 
The merchant had been looking for any clue, anything that could give him any lead to find out a way to help Cane, because it pained him to see how Iris looked so morose. 
He felt like her soul would die first before her body. 
"It’s a looooong, arduous journey that I have to go through! I have to fight monsters! Going through snowstorm..." 
"Lou, this is summer..." Iris reminded him. 
The merchant cleared his throat. "I meant... a great ordeal to get this piece of information." 
Iris wanted him to talk straight to the point, because she really wanted to know what he had found out, but she endured it. At the very least, after all the trouble that Lou had gone through, she would let him had his time to shine and brag about it. 
"It almost felt like I am looking for a needle in the ocean!" 
An hour passed and Iris still had the patient to listen to him, but Cane had decided to take a nap, as he used Iris’s legs as a pillow and slept on the carpet. Listening to Lou gave the king a headache. 
"... and finally, I found this man. He was from the not- so Holy Kingdom." Finally, Lou got to the main story. "He is very old, I though he is a relic." Lou looked very serious. 
Iris didn’t know whether she wanted to laugh or cry. She was so done with this merchant, but she loved him as a friend nonetheless. He was so dear to them and Lou had been amazing throughout the years they spent together. 
"I got information from him. He talked something about five swords and the power of the true Serafim. The hidden forest, where the swords were there." Lou frowned. "He talked in Andel language, I don’t understand some of the word he said." 
"How could you say that he can help with Cane’s case?" 
"Because he said something along the line of the missing memory, or mind...? The restoration of the power or something... anyway, it the same case like Cane. You should go and meet him yourself, you know about the Serafim power and the five swords better than me. I am sure you mentioned about the five swords long time ago." 
"Let’s go." Iris didn’t want to waste her time. If there was a way, she wanted to figure it out immediately. 
"Now?" 
"Yes." 
"Okay!" Lou immediately stood up. "It has been a long time, since we went onto a journey together!" 
"But, help me to get Cane to the bed first," Iris said, caressing Cane’s head. 
"What should I do?" 
"Carry him to the bed." 
"I am already too old!" Lou cried.
###Chapter 1005: BONUS - : AN OLD STORY
Chapter 1005: BONUS Chapter: AN OLD STORY
Iris remembered this old man, even though she had not yet seen him for more than sixteen years. He was the man from the black market. The old, bald and blind man. 
The last time she met him was during the war with Decratic. He told her about the light that came from the Serafim. The light that she had, which guided every soul to her. 
She didn’t remember his name, whether she remembered she had ever asked his name and Lou took her to him. 
"You can ask him." Lou sat down on the chair and helped himself with drink and snack. 
After the war, Iris didn’t really pay attention to him, because there were a lot of things that happened and many more people died. 
Iris didn’t even remember him until now. Even if she remembered him, she would assume that he died during the massive attack, where more than half of the population of the shifter was vanished.
"Oh, the bright woman..." He greeted her in Andel language. 
That was what he called her years ago. He still remembered even though years had passed. 
The blind man was living in this little house, which made it looked a little bit cramp with three people inside, but Lou didn’t really pay attention to that, he made himself at home. Iris wondered how long this merchant spent his time here. 
"I am afraid, I have not yet known your name. I am sorry for my ignorance." 
The blind man waved his hand, he looked so old, but more lively than the last time Iris met with him. "I had a name that I was born with, but right now, I was preferred to be called as Kal." 
"Kal." Iris sat down next to Lou and he nudged the snack on the table, but she was not in the mood to eat anything. "I am sure Lou had told you about why I came here." 
"So, it’s true... about what happened to the king. It’s a pity... he has been a great king."

It was believable, since people knew how much the king and the queen loved each other.

"I see, I know why you are looking for me." Kal sat down across from Iris and Lou.

"Do you know the story of the little girl and the monster?" Kal asked. 
"Yes, I know." Of course, she knew because she had been telling this story to all of her children, the children from the orphanage and Lu. She retold the story countless times.

"Do you know where did the original story come from?" 
"No." 
"Andel continent. There is a little bit revision here and there when it reached the other continent." The blind man leaned over, as if he was attracted to the light and smiled softly. "Do you know that the original story has been spread in Andel continent for centuries? The origin of it came from the first Serafim and the lycan." 
Iris was taken aback. She didn’t know about that. 
"See, I told you this part is very important and..." Lou immediately shut his mouth when Iris shot him a dagger look. 
Kal then retold the original story that came from Andel Continent, as he learned about this when he was still in the Holy Kingdom. 
Iris listened to that carefully, she didn’t realize that she had been telling story about Lu and Na all this time. 
No wonder, Lu always loved it whenever she told him that. With how much Lu loved Na, it did make sense to Iris now. 
That lycan would always want to clung onto anything about her. 
"The forest in the story, is the secret forest, where the Great Shrine was. The place that restored all the five swords that contained with the first Serafim’s power."

Iris didn’t think it did. "But, how can it help with Cane’s condition."

Yes, Lu had gone, but the curse in the lycan’s soul inflicted its host as well. Magic users will not realize this, because no one has ever encountered this kind of curse before."

The Great Shrine in the Andelus Continent.

"Let’s talk about this, three days from now, so we can see what option we have."

"Mother, is father sleeping? can we walk for a while?" Zander looked at his mother solemnly. When he stood in front of Iris right now, he was way taller than her. 
He looked like Cane, Iris imagined young Cane would look like their sons.

They walked for a while in the garden, the wind was rather warm and it was a clear night with the pale moonlight illuminated every dark corner of the palace.

Iris had expected this answer, but even if he asked them to stay, she could understand. 
"Will it make me the youngest king in the history?" Zander tried to lift up the mood with a joke. She was sure he picked this habit from Lou and Ethan.

###Chapter 1007: SIDE STORY (LOU): IN THE PAST
Chapter 1007: SIDE STORY (LOU): IN THE PAST
