Annelise had this beautiful smile on her lips, she was calm and collected when she carried her son in her arms. "Mama said not to play with them, right?" 
She wiped his tears. 
"But, why? I though they are my brothers?" 
"They are, Lou. They are your brothers."

"I am sorry, Lou. It’s mama fault." Annelise kissed her son and hugged him a little bit tighter. "Why don’t you play with mama?" 
Lou looked at his mother, he didn’t want to play with his mother because she had been sick and couldn’t run as fast as him, but the sad look on her eyes made him nodded. 
"Don’t cry, mama." Lou wiped his mother’s tears, in which Annelise didn’t even realize it. "I love you, mama. I am sorry for not listening to you."

Lou was confused about why his father didn’t love him and his mother and why he lived in a big house with his brothers, while he had to live in a rickety house that the roof looked like it would collapse in any moment. 
Lou also didn’t understand why there were a few men, who came to their house at night often. Lou didn’t like it, because every time these men came, he had to wait outside.

He was little, but he was well aware that they were very poor, thus money was very important.
When his father left and his mother wouldn’t get up from the bed, there was money on the table, but also a few coins here and there. 
After Lou gathered all the coins, he would hand them to his mother. "Look, mama. I found more coins. Can we buy meat?" he asked, but his mother would cry even more, while hugging him. 
Lou had to feed himself during that day, therefore he didn’t like it when his father came. He liked it more when those strange men came, because at the very least, he could eat meat the next day. 
And tonight, just like any other night, a man was inside with his mother. Lou had seen this man for more than a handful of time, he came very often recently and made his mother smiled often too. 
Lou liked it when his mother was smiling. She looked beautiful. 
But then, suddenly the door was opened when Lou was snacking, he looked up and saw the man smiled at him.

Since that night, whenever he came, Lou was allowed to stay inside the house and he came often. For some time, it was only this man and his father, who would come to check on him and his mother. 
Until one night when Lou felt his body was on fire.

After being kicked out from his own property, Lou intended to go to Iris, but at this hour, she most likely be with Cane and tended to him. He wanted to go to Redmond, but he didn’t want to see a child and that redhead warrior had a little girl. 
In the end, he went to Ethan’s place, but the gamma was away and there was only Aliana. 
"What are you doing here?" Aliana crossed her arms in front of her chest. She judged him. "You look so awful." 
"Nala just kicked me out." 
"I am going to do the same." 
Lou grumbled. "At the very least, let me in." 
"No. My mate is not here. I don’t want there is a rumor about it." 
Both of them made a look when they imagined there was such nasty rumor about them. That was very terrifying, more than anything that they had ever heard.

Lou had a lot of properties, countless houses, more than he needed, but he didn’t have a home. A place that he could call home did not exist. 
"I don’t have a place anywhere, Aliana." Lou rubbed his face roughly, he stared at the vast night sky. He didn’t even know what he wanted now. 
He was interested in Iris and seeing her would always excite him, but this feeling wouldn’t go anywhere. He didn’t think it would go somewhere either. 
"I don’t talk about place, Lou, sometime home is not always about a house, but someone that we are comfortable with." 
Aliana had heard what happened between him and Nala and she understood why this merchant looked like a headless chicken, but Lou was very stubborn to admit it, it was hard for him to accept something that he was not familiar with. 
Aliana felt bad for Lou, but that feeling changed in a blink of an eye with his respond. 
Lou frowned. "Don’t talk to me with gentle tone. You gave me goosebumps." He shuddered. "Being that kind doesn’t suit you." 
The sympathy that Aliana felt for him disappeared, evaporated into thin air. "Go away, Lou! Nala was right to kick you out! Scram!" 
"Hey! I am going, I am going!" Lou grumbled and then walked away. 
"I will let Ethan know that you come over," Aliana said before she closed the door and she indeed sent Ethan to Lou when the gamma just returned.

"I didn’t do anything!" Lou rubbed his back and caught the thing that Ethan tossed to him. It was a waterskin, but both of them knew what was inside. Lou indeed needed a little bit alcohol in his system. 
"You came with your morose look on your face." 
"Is that even a crime?" Lou gulped down the alcohol. "The city is still lively." 
"Tomorrow is the coronation." 
Both of them fell silent, as they immersed into the festivities. Those dark days during the war and the slavery seemed like a long dream, the memories during that time had started fading away, it replaced by good ones, though sometime it would come to hunt them in their nightmares, but it was not often. 
"So, you are leaving?" 
"Yes."

Ethan scoffed in disdain. Lou didn’t change at all. He still wanted to beat him up sometime. "And you are going to leave Nala and your baby behind?" 
With that question, Lou actually fell silent.

Actually, there was not much that the two of them were talking about, they didn’t even touch the main topic about why Lou was restless.

Lou looked hesitated. He was still hesitated to grasp the concept that he was going to be a father, but Nala took the initiative to take his hand and place it over her belly.

Lou widened his eyes. "Should I kick the baby back?" 
"Lou!" Nala got the pillow and started hitting him. 
"I am just joking! I am just joking! Stop hitting me!"

Meanwhile, he was standing there, hugging his only companion, as the kitten’s blood seeped through his ragged shirt. 
After the owner was satisfied scolding him, he left. There was not an ounce of pity for the poor little boy. 
And now, he was still sitting in the same place, where no one would bother him and his dead little kitten. 
He thought, he was going to die too, because he was starving. He was willing to kill for a piece of hard bread, so his stomach could stop hurting. 
However, no one wanted to look at his direction or give him even their remaining food. 
He was so hungry to the point, his vision started to get blurry. The kitten in his arms had smelled as bad as his surroundings and its little body had turned very cold. 
He wanted to let go, he wanted to die, because life was nothing, but very cruel to him, but at the same time, he wanted to live and have a bite of a meat. He had never tried one before. 
That was when someone came to him. 
That man had this stern look on his face and he approached him. He saw this little boy in the midst of trash. 
"Do you want to eat?" he asked. 
With his last strength, the little boy pulled a smile and chanted the same sentence that he had said countless time to the people, who walked past. 
"I can clean your house, I can lift heavy things, you can tell me what I have to do and I will get it done in no time," his voice was so small, but he put so much effort to look cheerful, because this man could be his piece of bread. "I don’t need too much and I can sleep everywhere. I can work and I am very diligent." 
The man didn’t say anything for a while, thus the boy started to speak again, afraid that he was going to lose this opportunity to fill his empty stomach. 
"I may look small and weak, but I am strong enough to lift heavy things and I..." 
"Follow me." 
That was the only thing that the man said and since then that little boy had been following him. He saw him as his savior when the whole world turned blind eyes on his misery, he was the only one, who reached to him and offered him help. 
The little boy remembered the warm bread that he ate and the warm soup that made his mouth watering, or the first meat he ate that night. 
That man was very quiet, he didn’t say anything and only give him one line order, but in the boy’s eyes, he was like an angel. 
"I can eat all of this?" he asked when this man took him to a fancy inn, where people dress very nicely and all of them looked at him as if he was shit on the tip of their shoes. 
"Yes. Eat them all and clean yourself." 
"What job should I do?" He asked, but the man didn’t answer, thus he started to eat. It felt like a dream when the fluffy bread entered his mouth or when the hot and savory soup warmed his stomach. The meat was very soft, it was like a butter, though he had never tried a butter before, since it was considered as an expensive food. 
That man didn’t answer the question again. "What’s your name?" 
The boy immediately swallowed down the bread so he could answer him quickly. "Letto. People called me Letto. But, if sir wanted to call me with something else, that will be my name from now on." 
The man didn’t say anything about it, but later on, Letto learned that his name was Dexter. 
After Letto finished with his meal, he had a room prepared for him and a warm water to take a bath. He scrubbed his skin from dirt and spent two hours doing so, because he wanted to look presentable for his new master. 
Moreover, he had new pair of clothes and pants. He didn’t want to dirty them. 
However, before he could enjoy his bed, it seemed he had to go out for a while. Letto sneaked out and went to the empty alley where he left his little kitten because he couldn’t possibly bring the dead animal with him when he followed his new master. 
He wanted to burry his little kitten, but when he got there, his little kitten was nowhere to be seen, he could only see the blood on the ground. 
A dog or any other animal must have taken away his poor little companion, since there were so many astray dogs around this area and most of the time, Letto needed to fight with the hungry dog too for a piece of food. 
Letto felt bad. He should have hidden the kitten’s body better, so no dog would find it. He should have put it into a trash full of garbage, so the dog wouldn’t dig it. 
With a heavy heart, Letto headed back to the inn. He prayed that his kitten would finally find a good place, just like him and with that, he fell asleep because he was very exhausted and also for the first time since he could remember, he slept with a full stomach. He didn’t need to listen to the growling from his empty stomach now. 
For some people, sleeping with stomach full was not something that they were grateful for because they used to it, but for people like Letto, it was a blissful feeling to not being hungry when he was sleeping. 
And for the first time, Letto woke up with a smile on his face. He was looking forward to the task that his master would give to him. 
Letto was a smart boy, who learned so fast and Dexter was actually nice enough to teach him how to read and write. He was so happy to learn that from him and after some time, he managed to get a hold of his master’s habit. He knew what his master wanted only by reading his body language and he became his best lackey, not like his master had anyone else aside from him. 
He learned that his master was a magic user, a black magic user. 
At first, he was shocked, because he knew that black magic user would do something bad, but then, he couldn’t care less what he did to other people, since he was very nice to him. He provided him with everything that he needed and even more than enough. 
And just like how the people didn’t care about him when he was sitting near the trash bin in the Greazly city as they minded their own business, Letto also did the same thing. 
He didn’t care what his master did to hurt people, as long as he treated him nicely and he didn’t need to sleep with empty stomach. 
That was how powerful food was for people like him. 
He followed him around for five years to all over the places in the Karam continent. They had never stayed in one place for long and then one day, Dexter told him that they were going to Ogregon continent. 
"To the continent of the shifter?" Letto asked, as he wiped Dexter’s shoes. "I heard that place is not good. What are we doing there?" 
"Just prepared everything like usual." 
With that Letto didn’t ask much, but he was excited because they were going to go on a big ship. If you wanted to reach the other continent, you need a big ship to cross the sea. 
This was the first time he would be on a ship and he couldn’t hold back his excitement when they reached the harbor and many ships were docked there. 
"Where is our ship, master?!" Letto asked, as he carried their things, trying to pick up his pace with his master. 
Their luggage looked heavy, but he had gotten used to it and even more because he had enough strength now. 
"Woah! This is so great!" 
"Letto." 
"Yes, master?" 
"Be quiet." 
Letto shrilled without sound after that, he was still excited to see the world beyond the sea. He wondered how his future would be. 
He wondered what experience that waited for him in this new continent. 
"Master, why don’t you a woman? Another man will have two women, at least, but you have none." Letto asked Dexter one night after they finished their dinner. The sky and the sea looked so dark, he wondered how people navigated the direction in this darkness. 
Dexter pushed away his plate and stared into the darkness too. When Letto thought his master wouldn’t answer his question, he actually replied to him. 
"I had a woman before. She died." Dexter looked at Letto. "Do you want to have a woman?" 
Letto blushed. "I want to have a family, master. I think I can afford a family now."
###Chapter 1026: SIDE STORY (DEXTER): THE BRIGHT LIGHT
Chapter 1026: SIDE STORY (DEXTER): THE BRIGHT LIGHT
"I had a woman before. She died." Dexter looked at Letto. 
Dexter didn’t want to remember about this, but in the past, he used to have a woman that he liked, but with the life that he lived in, it was not possible to have someone by his side without risking their life. 
Aria. 
That woman’s name was Aria. 
That woman was beautiful. Her smile was the brightest and Dexter had never seen someone, who could make him forgot about all the adversity in his life. 
How long it had been since the last time he saw her? Twenty years? Twenty five years? 
After all, the two of them were very young, probably sixteen? Seventeen? Dexter lost count. He was no longer counting days and just breezed through this life. 
Aria. Her name was beautiful, just like her. 
She had dimples on both of her cheeks, her brown eyes and brown hair made brown became the color that Dexter loved. 
Every time she talked, her eyes would twinkle and even after so many years had passed, Dexter still remembered the day he met her for the first time. 
He was the son of the head of their secret community, where his father was a respected figure and that day, his father took him and his sister to visit a small village. 
It was a very poor village in the middle of nowhere, where people had to walk five hours to reach the nearby city. 
But, of course, this was a perfect place for people like them. These people were easily fooled. These people were the perfect target for their ritual... 
"You must be Sir Zeke’s son." 
A young girl approached Dexter with a jar of water, she gave it to him with a bright smile on her lips. Water was difficult to get, but for the villagers’ gratitude for Zeke and his people’s help, they made their stay here became more pleasant. 
Zeke came with a lot of food and opportunity for business in the city. 
"Yes." 
"What’s your name?" 
Dexter had never had a friend, especially someone at his age, the people that around him would be his father’s follower and they definitely couldn’t fall into a friend category, the only person that was around his age was his sister. 
"Dexter." 
Dexter was not sure whether this was the right thing to do, because he was not supposed to be friendly with anyone, but he thought, this girl wouldn’t do any harm on him. 
More so, he was a magic user, what this girl could do to him? 
"I am Aria!" she said, it sounded like a song for him. 
And since that day, Dexter would often be seen with her. She took him to play around with the other kid and even take him with her parents to the city. 
"You shouldn’t be so close with her." 
His father said one day. He looked at Dexter in the eyes. His son was very obedient, but recently, he started to give a sign of rebelling. 
He spent so much time with the people here and created unnecessary bond with them. 
"You will be in trouble if you created a bond with them. We are leaving in two weeks." 
"What about this village?" 
"This is not the first time, right? You know what will happen." 
This was not the first poor village that they visited and of course, this wouldn’t be the last, but for all the villages that they had visited, it would be definitely their last. 
"Don’t get involved with her too much. It will be difficult for you." 
After saying that, Zeke left his son alone, but Dexter didn’t show any reaction. He just stood there and stared at his father’s back. 
Two weeks and then this village would be vanished. The people would disappear and he knew exactly what would happen to them. 
Two weeks. 
"In two weeks will have a festival!" Aria said, she approached Dexter, as she climbed the rock and stared at the dessert. The sun was so bright, but it didn’t bother them at all. "This will be the first time our village will hold a festival, it’s all thank to your father. He is a very great man!" 
Aria then talked about what dress that she would wear, the dress that she bought when they went to the city the last time. She was very excited for the festival, without knowing what actually would happen. 
"Why are you very quiet? Don’t you feel very excited?" Her brown eyes looked almost like they were golden when the ray of light fell on her face. "Oh... I think you are not as excited as me because this must not be your first festival, right?" 
She looked a little bit down, but her smile was so wide when she asked Dexter to tell her about all the festival that he had seen. 
Yes, this wouldn’t be his first festival, but the end of the festival wouldn’t be as exciting as Aria would think. 
There would be a lot of deaths after that.

"What do you mean?" Aria looked confused with what he said, but Dexter didn’t say anything anymore. He jumped from the rock and then left. 
For the next few days, Dexter avoided her. 
His father was right, he shouldn’t have involved with this woman. This woman was dangerous. Just like his mother. His mother was trying to kill him and his sister when they were little when she learned that they actively involved in the black magic. 
His mother hated them because they inherited the same power like their father. Woman only brought trouble. That was what his father said. That was why, his father was so proud of him. 
Because of that, Dexter had to live up to his expectation. He couldn’t let his father down. 
He couldn’t tell Aria to run away because the night of the festival would be the night of the disaster. Therefore, he couldn’t keep seeing her.

"Did I do something wrong? Did I talk something wrong? Why did you keep avoiding me?" Aria looked sad when she talked to him. She managed to drag him to an empty alley between two houses. 
Meanwhile, in the distance, the festivity had started. 
She looked beautiful like usual, wearing the dress that she had been gushing about. The dress was in the same color like her eyes and her hair.

It would be too late for her to warn her family, but if she just ran away herself, she might make it to the nearest city. His father and his people wouldn’t have noticed if there was one person went missing. 
"You need to leave."

Dexter shouldn’t have done this, but when he saw a firework was brightened up the night sky, he knew he didn’t have time anymore. 
He stared at the woman before his eyes, the light of the firework fell on her face and she stared at the sky, astonished. 
She looked genuinely happy, Dexter wanted to stare at her face for a long time. He felt like he could stare at her expression and his pure happiness for the rest of his life and be contented with it. 
However, the reality was not so kind. He was going to lose her if they stayed here. 
"Come. Come with me," Dexter said. He grabbed her hand and started to run away toward different direction from the festivity. 
As they started running, they could hear the first scream that split the night followed by the second and the third and then all they could hear was everybody was screaming. 
"What is going on?" Aria was terrified. "What’s happening?" 
"Don’t look back, keep running!" Dexter shouted. 
He didn’t know what he was thinking, but he needed to get her away from here. He needed to save her. All the people in this village could be his father’s sacrifice, but not her! 
"No! My family is there!" Aria cried, she wanted to go back, but Dexter held her hand so tight, she couldn’t get away from his grip. 
"There is nothing you can do! All of them are going to die!" 
"What?" Aria staggered back, her mind went blank, but Dexter knew they didn’t have time. His life was also in danger for going against his father’s order. 
"We need to reach the nearest city as soon as possible, we need to get away from here!" Dexter kept dragging Aria with him, because she was in so much shock, she couldn’t think of a better way to respond to this information. 
Meanwhile, in the distance, the screams of the villagers were getting louder, it almost sounded like they were being slaughtered if that even made any sense. 
"Wait... wait..." Aria was shaking, she couldn’t breathe. Her legs gave in after they ran for an hour straight. "Please, explain to me... what happened..." 
"Later, I will explain to you later." He needed to save her. He needed to save her first. 
"I can’t run anymore..." 
Dexter knelt down and gave his back to her. "Hop on. We need to keep moving."
###Chapter 1027: SIDE STORY (DEXTER): GRIEF
Chapter 1027: SIDE STORY (DEXTER): GRIEF
Deep down, Dexter knew it was a futile attempt for him to get away from this current situation. He wouldn’t be able to save Aria. 
But still, he didn’t stop running with her on his back. She was too shocked to move when she finally realized she lost her parents and the people that she knew.

In this lifetime, they would start again properly...
